question: How did global temperature anomaly change by decade, and which decade jumped most?
summary: Global temperature anomalies show a clear long-term warming trend, rising from an average of -0.217 °C in the 1880s to +1.067 °C in the 2020s, a difference of 1.284 °C between the two decade averages. The largest increase between consecutive decade averages occurred from the 2010s to the 2020s, rising by 0.261 °C. Note that the 2020s cover only 6 years so far, so that decade is incomplete. The linear trend across decade averages is +0.087 °C per decade.
